After being disappointed by Civ 7, I decided to start making my own Civ-style game. What do you guys think of the leader selection screen and the in-game UI?

I’m still working on the visuals and trying to keep them simple enough to run on pretty much any potato, while still adding some nice animations and visual effects here and there.

replies.author: count023
replies.body:
yea, so far i hvae a full terrain generator done, the only contiguous parts so far are nebula or anomaly zones like that. But i basically made sure that adding new terrain types was a simple as creating an XML or JSONL with the terrain specifics and it gets lazy overloaded into available resources at startup time. 

Makes it so much easier to add new terrain, anomalies and such, just by having a basic "tile class" value with what's needed to render, then you overload that table with each of your specific entires that has an object key so anomalies can be added or generated as easy as adding a key. 

Not gonna lie, i did feed an AI some of the data files for Stellaris and Civ6 for optimizations of my data structure, but in general, it works :)
